subject: Success criteria sync: systems ownership & procurement handshake
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluepeak.com>, Sahil Gupta <sahil.gupta@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Success criteria sync: systems ownership & procurement handshake

Hi Emily / Sahil —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. As promised, here’s a short recap and a proposed ownership/RACI starting point so we can kick off the pilot next week. I attached a one-page scope (POC-scope-BluePeak.pdf) — please review alongside the notes below.

Quick recap of outcomes from the demo/discovery:
- Goal: Validate LLM-powered anomaly summaries for BluePeak dashboards and measure 95th pct latency under production-like load.
- Core success criteria (suggested):
  * Functional: accurate summaries for 10 canonical dashboards (team-supplied prompt set), precision > 85% on labeled samples.
  * Performance: p95 generation latency < 750ms at steady-state QPS (projected 5 RPS for test harness).
  * Cost: per-token unit cost estimate within the agreed guardrail (TBD with procurement).
  * Security/Compliance: audit logs enabled; model I/O not persisted outside customer-controlled KV for PII queries.

Proposed ownership (initial):
- BluePeak: app owner (ingestion, prompt mappings) — Sahil.
- BluePeak: procurement/contract —Emily + IT procurement (cc).
- Redwood: infra & runtime (dedicated pool), model selection & rolling configs — Ben.
- Redwood: security checklist & SOC2 evidence — Karthik / Priyom.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can BluePeak confirm the app/integration owner (who will be the day-to-day contact for infra handoffs)?
2) Sahil — please confirm the 10 dashboards and share the sample IDs by EOD Tue.
3) Emily / procurement — please ping the procurement contact and share any template timelines (we typically need a 10 business-day turnaround for small POs).
4) Ben / Karthik / Priyom — we’ll circulate a RACI draft and a tentative 3-week test timeline; please flag any blockers.

Attachments: POC-scope-BluePeak.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a RACI draft by 11:30am PT.

—Marissa

Subject: Re: Success criteria sync: systems ownership & procurement handshake

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Looping in Procurement (it-procurement@bluepeak.com).

Quick answers:
- App owner confirmed: Sahil will own the integration and the dashboard list. He’ll send the 10 canonical dashboards by Tuesday EOD; he also asked whether you have a sample mapping format to speed ingestion.
- Procurement: we have a standard SaaS PO process and a security questionnaire (we’ll share). Procurement lead is Jen Lo (copied as it-procurement@bluepeak.com). For small pilots they usually approve within 7-12 business days if SOW and SOW attached invoice terms are standard.
- Security: we need to validate that audit logs are available for token-level requests and that model inputs are not stored in a shared analytics bucket. Can Redwood provide the security checklist and the expected retention settings?

We appreciate the timeline. One more ask: can Redwood provide a quick draft RACI so internal stakeholders at BluePeak can sign off faster? A spreadsheet would be ideal.

Thanks — looking forward to the RACI draft.

—Emily

Thanks — I put together a quick ops-first plan and a RACI draft (raci-draft-BluePeak.xlsx). High level notes below and an ask for an infra handoff window.

Operational plan (3-week pilot, tentative):
Week 0 (prep, this week): contract/PO sign, security checklist review, infra provisioning (dedicated dev pool).
Week 1 (ingestion & mapping): BluePeak ships sample dashboards + prompts; Redwood configures model, prompt templates, initial prefix/KV caching.
Week 2 (load & tuning): run load through test harness (5 RPS steady-state), tune batching/sequence settings to hit p95 latency target.
Week 3 (validation & handover): compare labeled samples against generated summaries, handover runbook and cost estimate.

Proposed RACI owners (draft):
- Ingestion / Prompt mapping: R = BluePeak (Sahil), A = BluePeak Product (Emily), C = Redwood (Ben)
- Infra provisioning (dedicated pool): R = Redwood (Ben), A = Redwood (Ben), C = BluePeak IT
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence: R = Redwood (Karthik / Priyom), A = BluePeak Security (TBD), C = Procurement
- Procurement & PO: R = BluePeak Procurement (Jen), A = BluePeak Finance, C = Redwood Sales Ops

Infra handoff ask: Sahil — can you confirm a 2-hour window the week of 6/28 where BluePeak engineers can be available for testing the network egress and firewall rules? We need to validate private endpoints + certificate exchange.

Attachments: raci-draft-BluePeak.xlsx, redwood-security-checklist.pdf

—Ben
